zh: 定时任务面板升级：支持分页浏览、关键词检索与状态筛选，新增立即手动执行一次与删除单条任务记录，并优化定时任务与桌面智能体界面细节。
桌面端模型请求接入 Electron 网络栈以自动遵循系统与企业代理/PAC 配置，同时兼容仅填域名或网关前缀的 Anthropic 接口基地址（自动补全 /v1）。
en: Upgraded scheduled tasks with paginated browsing, keyword search and status filtering, manual run-now execution, single-record deletion, and UI refinements across schedules and desktop agents.
Desktop AI model requests now route through Electron's network stack to honor system/enterprise proxies and PAC rules, and Anthropic base URLs without a version segment automatically append /v1.
